caption:
You were right 🔥

Send this to everyone who called you a conspiracy theorist for speaking the truth
video_overlay_text_observed: On-screen captions: 'Lab leak COVER-UP', 'so a CIA...'. Speaker is podcaster Kaylor Betts reacting to C-SPAN footage of the May 13 2026 HSGAC hearing (James Erdman III testifying).
implied_frame: Frames the May 2026 HSGAC whistleblower hearing as vindication that COVID was a covered-up lab leak. Verified facts (Group A): the hearing happened (Erdman testified under subpoena, 2026-05-13, full video on C-SPAN); every Democratic senator skipped it. Verified-as-testimony but ATTRIBUTED allegations (Group B): Fauci's 'intentional' role; the 'conflicted list of curated SMEs' incl. Proximal Origin authors (verbatim from testimony); the Aug 12-17 2021 CIA assessment change (testimony says lab-incident -> non-consensus, reel says 'going to publicly call lab leak'); CIA analysts (6 of 7 technical experts) favoring lab leak before management overrode it; NIH/NIAID funding of EcoHealth->WIV. Reel ADDS a claim not in the testimony: the ~$8.9M ('$9 million') NIAID grant to Proximal Origin author Kristian Andersen 'right after he flipped' — grant real, quid-pro-quo contested (Andersen says applied 2019, calls it 'absurd and false'). Rhetorical (Group C): 'biggest fear and manipulation campaign of all time', 'this was never about science / we were right the whole time'. Full hearing archived at sources/captures/DYYLACQDnG1/hearing/.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~24.9 MB); delivery ~25.4 MB webm, 162s.
